mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies and 75-degree weather near Fireman's Park, with the third quarter moon visible tonight and an overnight low of 66 degrees with rain on the way.

The City of Verona has some great updates, including a new tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center where you can enjoy free rides on the Military Ridge State Trail, and new seasonal job openings at the Recreation Department for those looking to help the community.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga, the downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia at the Bogey Factory happening tomorrow.
In our weekly report, we noted an incident on August 2 where a 49-year-old Verona man was taken into custody on charges including bail jumping and resisting arrest.
Today is the perfect time to visit Culver's for the delicious Butter Pecan flavor of the day, as they are open until 10 PM this evening.
